userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Vehicle barrier: a barrier arm.
Vehicle barrier: a rolling or overhead door.
Vehicle barrier: a retractable bollard.
Vehicle barrier: one-way tyre spikes.
Pedestrian barrier: a door a parker authenticates at to enter the facility, for example after hours to reach their car. Place-level equipment with no lane.
Pedestrian barrier: a turnstile at a pedestrian entrance.
Ticketing: the entry station that issues a ticket or token.
Ticketing: the exit station that reads the ticket or credential and opens the gate.
Payment: a pay-in-lane station at the exit (APDS type paymentMachine).
Payment: a central pay station away from the lanes (APDS type paymentMachine).
Payment: a staffed booth.
Payment: a merchant validator.
Payment: a standalone card or tap terminal.
Credential reader: an access or proximity card reader.
Credential reader: an RFID, transponder or AVI tag reader.
Credential reader: a QR or barcode reader for reservations and mobile passes.
Vehicle detection: an in-ground loop.
Vehicle detection: a non-loop vehicle sensor (radar, ultrasonic, magnetic).
A camera anywhere on the site; what it looks at, how it is mounted and how it is viewed are in the apds-ext:apx:camera@1.0 decoration (Part 26 §26.3).
Communications: a help button with two-way audio and/or video.
Communications: a help button on a phone line.
Communications: a dedicated emergency call box.
Signs and displays: a message screen at the lane.
Signs and displays: an open/closed light or traffic light.
Signs and displays: a spaces-available sign.
On-site infrastructure: a lane computer or controller.
On-site infrastructure: the on-site PARCS server.
On-site infrastructure: a DVR or NVR; a camera's recorder points here.
On-site infrastructure: the gateway that issues short-lived camera links (Part 26 §26.4).
Hardware none of the other codes fit. A code, not free text; propose a new code rather than describing the item in prose.
